correctness.rationale: The inverse-clock assumption is on the independent, strictly increasing, nonkilled D. Since independent Poisson epochs are almost surely continuity times for D, physical batch epochs are D(T_j): the inverse crosses T_j at D(T_j−)=D(T_j). Conditional on the iid exponential durations the D-increments are independent and depend only on their respective durations, so after averaging the positive waits are iid with transform λ/(λ+g(s)) and mean μ=d/λ; they are independent of marks. The n-th gap is positive just at a renewal boundary n−1. For n<k the joint boundary probability is u_(n−1)u_(k−n) and the waits used are distinct, proving Eq. (1), including n=1 and applicability with just finite first moment for distinct gaps. The adjacent covariance is μ²u_(n−1)(q−u_n); u_(n−1)>0 from the all-singleton history. The generating function factors using (1−z)(1+az+az²). Its coefficients give u_n=1/m+(2a/m)r^n[cos(nθ)+κ sin(nθ)], as also checked by the two initial values of the transient. Since q−1/m=a(2q−1)/m, the noncritical eventual signs are strict. At q=1/2, 2cosθ=−1/√2 has nonintegral algebraic norm, so θ/π is irrational; both sign arcs then have infinitely many visits bounded away from zero and give the stated two-sided subsequence magnitudes. For the uniform cutoff, put h=−log r, δ=q−1/2. A bounded sinusoidal amplitude gives the upper bound log(1/|δ|)/h+O(1); compactness of the phase circle gives a fixed finite block hitting strict interior arcs of both signs for rotation at criticality. Uniform continuity over that finite block preserves the two hits at nearby q for every starting phase. A block a fixed distance before the threshold therefore contains a strict opposite-sign anomaly, uniformly on both sides. Replacing h by (log 2)/2 costs O(|δ|log(1/|δ|)). For size {1,2}, u_n−q=[a²+a(−a)^n]/(1+a)>0 for n≥2, and unit-only marks give independent waits. Frozen verify.py was inspected but not executed; its finite assertions do not prove the infinite phase or uniform cutoff. An independent exact-rational recurrence diagnostic on n=2,…,128 for q=1/2±2^(−j), j=8,12,16,24,32, gave final sampled anomaly indices within four of 2j; this is supplementary only.
